title: Bruno
summary: Bruno is a young orphan with blonde hair and a plump build who lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and became a member of the Blood Spiral.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Bruno would regularly bully Harrison Fears with Dirk and the other orphans, which often resulted in fights with Den Fears, who fought to protect his little brother and the other weaker kids at the orphanage. [Den vs Harrison]

When Tantras and the Blood Spiral came to the orphanage in search of recruits, Bruno and Dirk were both given the Titan Harlekin. After being ordained with the mark of the Spiral by Rassimov, the orphans were sent to ambush Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill. They were forced to retreat however when Dante Vale arrived to back up his team. [Den vs Harrison] 

Despite joining the Blood Spiral, Bruno was the only orphan from the Rotterdam orphanage who was not selected to be tutored by Tantras. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

full_text:
Bruno is a young orphan with blonde hair and a plump build who lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and became a member of the Blood Spiral.

== History ==
Bruno would regularly bully Harrison Fears with Dirk and the other orphans, which often resulted in fights with Den Fears, who fought to protect his little brother and the other weaker kids at the orphanage. [Den vs Harrison]

When Tantras and the Blood Spiral came to the orphanage in search of recruits, Bruno and Dirk were both given the Titan Harlekin. After being ordained with the mark of the Spiral by Rassimov, the orphans were sent to ambush Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill. They were forced to retreat however when Dante Vale arrived to back up his team. [Den vs Harrison] 

Despite joining the Blood Spiral, Bruno was the only orphan from the Rotterdam orphanage who was not selected to be tutored by Tantras. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

== Personality ==
Like the other orphans, Bruno was a cowardly bully who constantly tormented Harrison at any opportunity. However, his cowardice was exposed when he came face to with the Fog Monsters, hiding behind his Harlekin Titan. [S2E33] It is likely due to his cowardice that he was the only orphan, excluding Den, not to be chosen as one of the students taught by Tantras. [S2E36]

== Abilities ==
This orphan was a thug who picked on those weaker than him. He was, however, able to use basic powers as taught to him by Tantras. [Den vs Harrison]
